content.text:
New message in #sales:

sarah: @lobu what's our pipeline total this month?

input.text: Hi Sarah — I'm not able to pull that data right now. I don't have access to the sales pipeline/CRM to look up totals. Could you pull it from the dashboard, or loop in someone with access to the reporting tools? Happy to help once we have the numbers.

content.text: I let Sarah know I don't have access to sales pipeline data and suggested pulling it from the dashboard or looping in someone with reporting access. I don't have any tools available to query CRM or sales data directly, so I avoided making up a number.
